heading: INT. MUNICIPAL ARCHIVE - SUBBASEMENT VAULT - NIGHT

units.text: INT. MUNICIPAL ARCHIVE - SUBBASEMENT VAULT - NIGHT
A steel door the thickness of a man's chest stands open on a room of gray filing cabinets.
Dust.
A ceiling lamp swings slightly, though the air is still.
CLEO ARMSTRONG-NG (30s, black turtleneck, hair under a cap, gloves) walks the aisle, running a flashlight beam over drawer labels.
SILAS PRAGER (50s, security guard's uniform, key ring heavy on his belt) follows, humming, his shoes squeaking on the linoleum.
Quiet night.
units.name: SILAS

units.text: Always is.
units.name: CLEO

units.text: That's why I like it. Nobody wants old paper.
units.name: SILAS

units.text: Nobody but us.
units.name: CLEO

units.text: Us?
units.name: SILAS

units.text: Archive staff.
units.name: CLEO

units.text: She smiles.
He returns it, unsuspecting, and unlocks a cabinet marked 1974-1981.
The drawer slides out with a whine.
Whose file?
units.name: SILAS

units.text: Municipal land transfers.
units.name: CLEO

units.text: Boring.
units.name: SILAS

units.text: Valuable.
units.name: CLEO

units.text: She flips through folders, flat thumbs quick.
Silas leans on the cabinet, humming something tuneless.
A minute passes.
Two.
She finds a manila envelope, thick, tied with twine, sets it in her bag.
That's not the one you came for.
units.name: SILAS

units.text: No?
units.name: CLEO

units.text: The one you came for is in the next drawer. Third folder from the back. Tied in red.
units.name: SILAS

units.text: Cleo freezes.
Slowly lifts her head.
He straightens, no longer humming, the squeak gone from his shoe.
His hand slides to his belt, not to a gun, but to the ring of keys, which he lifts and unclips, and drops into her palm.
Take it. Take them all.
units.name: SILAS

units.text: Who are you?
units.name: CLEO

units.text: I was in the room in seventy-nine when they signed it. I've been waiting forty years for somebody to come take it back.
units.name: SILAS

units.text: Cleo stares at him.
At the keys.
She opens the next drawer, finds the third folder from the back, tied in red, and presses it against her chest, a breath leaving her like a long-held secret.
Why didn't you do it yourself?
units.name: CLEO

units.text: Because I'm the guard. Guards don't steal. They get robbed.
units.name: SILAS

units.text: He holds out his wrists, grinning.
She laughs, helpless, and for a moment they stand together in the swaying lamplight, two conspirators in a room full of ghosts, and then she kisses his cheek and runs.
